text:
Lina: Heads-up — Catalyst Health SI onboarding hit a blocker in staging. Image verification fails plus egress to partner registry is getting 403s. This is blocking the implementation window today, need an architecture quick check and escalation if needed.

Marco: On it. When did this start? Can you paste the exact error and the netpolicy snippet? I can be on a call in 15.

Priya: Repro steps and short logs: `helm upgrade --install catalyst ./charts/catalyst -n catalyst-staging` -> pods crash with `ImagePullBackOff`.
Logs: ```
Error: image verification failed: public key not found for signature
GET https://private.marketplace.internal/v2/catalyst/blobs/sha256:... -> 403 Forbidden
```
Netpolicy (egress block): ```yaml
egress:
  - to: 10.0.0.0/8
    ports: [80,443]
```

Jules: Looks like the signing key didn't propagate to the staging KMS tenant. @Owen did the KMS rotation job finish last night?

Owen: Rotation job hit a transient API failure for tenant-catalyst. I aborted and queued a rerun. Re-running now — ETA ~12m.

deploy-bot: staging/catalyst-backend failed to deploy (image-pull-backoff) — https://ci.redwood.internal/1234

Marco: If KMS push won't finish in 15m we can fall back to the pre-pulled cache registry (redwood-cache/catalyst). That requires a temporary netpolicy exception to allow egress to 10.4.2.7:5000 from the staging namespace. Security, can we get a quick rule for this? :eyes:

Lina: @Security can we get emergency netpolicy exception? This is blocking the SI implementation window with the partner.

Priya: Also found a small client change needed: marketplace client needs to trust key id `catalyst-signing-v2`. Quick patch: ```diff
- trust_keys: ["catalyst-signing"]
+ trust_keys: ["catalyst-signing","catalyst-signing-v2"]
```
I can push a hotfix if needed.

Jules: Created infra ticket RED-31415 and added logs + KMS job output. https://org.atlassian.net/browse/RED-31415

Owen: KMS push completed — keys visible in tenant-catalog. Re-triggering pull on staging nodes.

deploy-bot: redeploy started for staging/catalyst-backend (build 2026.03.22-78)

Marco: Redeploy succeeded, pods transitioned to Running. Initial health checks OK. Can folks validate app layer?

Lina: Verified startup logs and smoke tests — app is up and health checks passing in staging. :tada:

Priya: Confirmed signature verification now succeeds and images pulled from private.marketplace.internal. No further 403s.

Marco: Phew. Follow-ups: 1) Add KMS propagation check to the SI preflight checklist, 2) Add a prepull fallback to the runbook with netpolicy exception steps, 3) Add key id compatibility test to client CI. I'll open PRs for the runbook changes.

Lina: Thanks everyone — great response. I'll update the partner and shift the go-live to proceed with the current window. We'll capture theretro items in RED-31415. :white_check_mark:
